title: Definition of Partition Function
description: Essential Criteria: Provide a correct definition of the partition function z for statistical systems.

title: Relation to Heat Capacity
description: Essential Criteria: Derive the correct relationship between heat capacity and the second derivative of ln z with respect to beta.

title: Expression for Heat Capacity
description: Essential Criteria: Present the correct expression for heat capacity in terms of the energy difference Delta.

title: Temperature Dependence Discussion
description: Important Criteria: Discuss the temperature dependence of the heat capacity and its limiting behavior at high and low temperatures.

title: Mathematical Accuracy
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid common errors in mathematical expressions, such as sign mistakes or missing factors.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivations and final expressions.
